moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins this Friday, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City in the opening match.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: Football's back! The Premier League season kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Coventry's Return
angles.copy: After 25 years, Coventry City are back in the Premier League! They face champions Arsenal on Friday night. Huge moment for the Sky Blues.

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures Preview
angles.copy: Beyond Friday's opener, the Premier League weekend sees Man Utd, Liverpool, Chelsea, and Man City all in action. Which game are you most excited for?

moments.title: Community Shield Aftermath
moments.blurb: Manchester City defeated Arsenal in the Community Shield in Cardiff on Sunday, securing the first silverware of the 2026/27 season.

angles.name: First Trophy Won
angles.copy: The Community Shield is in the bag! What a start to the season for Manchester City after their win over Arsenal in Cardiff.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Cardiff played host to the Community Shield on Sunday, bringing a major curtain-raiser to Principality Stadium. Great to see top-flight football in Wales!

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Ongoing
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, continues until August 31st, bringing thousands of performers and shows to Scotland's capital.

angles.name: Fringe Fever
angles.copy: Edinburgh is alive with the sound of laughter, music, and drama! The Fringe Festival is in full swing until the end of the month.

angles.name: Scotland's Cultural Hub
angles.copy: From comedy to cabaret, theatre to dance, the Edinburgh Fringe is showcasing incredible talent across the city. What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: Green Man Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Green Man Festival, a beloved independent music and arts festival in the Brecon Beacons, Wales, runs from August 20th to 23rd.

angles.name: Green Man Begins
angles.copy: Get ready for some magic! Green Man Festival opens its gates in the beautiful Brecon Beacons this Thursday. Who's heading to Wales for the weekend?

angles.name: Welsh Festival Vibes
angles.copy: The Brecon Beacons will be buzzing with music, arts, and good vibes as Green Man Festival kicks off on Thursday. Wishing everyone a legendary weekend!

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating world-class music, wellness, and culture, takes place in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, from August 20th to 23rd.

source.l: We Out Here Festival Official Site

angles.name: Dorset Groove
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival starts this Thursday in Dorset! Get ready for four days of incredible music, good food, and great vibes curated by Gilles Peterson.

angles.name: Sold Out Success
angles.copy: It's a sold-out success for We Out Here Festival! If you're lucky enough to be heading to Dorset this weekend, prepare for an unforgettable experience.

moments.title: ArcTanGent Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The ArcTanGent Festival, known for its focus on experimental rock and metal, runs from August 19th to 22nd in Compton Martin, Somerset.

angles.name: Alt-Rock Alert
angles.copy: ArcTanGent Festival kicks off tomorrow in Somerset! Three days of the best in experimental rock and metal are about to descend.

angles.name: Metal Mayhem
angles.copy: Calling all rock and metal fans! ArcTanGent is here, bringing a heavy lineup to Somerset from Wednesday. Who are you most hyped to see?

moments.title: The Voice UK Returns to ITV1
moments.blurb: A new series of The Voice UK, the popular singing competition, premieres on ITV1 this Saturday, August 22nd at 7pm.

angles.name: New Voice Season
angles.copy: The spinning chairs are back! The Voice UK returns for a brand new series this Saturday on ITV1 at 7pm. Who's ready for some incredible voices?

angles.name: Saturday Night TV
angles.copy: Your Saturday night TV just got a boost! The Voice UK is back this weekend. Who do you think will be on the coaching panel this year?

moments.title: Liam Howlett (The Prodigy) Turns 55
moments.blurb: Liam Howlett, co-founder and mastermind of electronic music pioneers The Prodigy, celebrates his 55th birthday on August 21st.

angles.name: Prodigy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Firestarter! Liam Howlett of The Prodigy turns 55 this Friday. What's your favourite track from the electronic trailblazers?

angles.name: Still a Force
angles.copy: Happy 55th to Liam Howlett, the driving force behind The Prodigy! His influence on dance and rock music is undeniable.

moments.title: Serj Tankian (System Of A Down) Turns 59
moments.blurb: Serj Tankian, the iconic lead vocalist of System Of A Down, celebrates his 59th birthday this Friday, August 21st.

angles.name: SOAD Frontman's Day
angles.copy: Happy 59th birthday to the one and only Serj Tankian from System Of A Down this Friday! What's your go-to SOAD anthem?

angles.name: Metal Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating Serj Tankian's 59th this Friday! The voice behind System Of A Down's biggest hits, still rocking strong.

moments.title: Kelis Turns 47
moments.blurb: Grammy-nominated R&B and soul singer Kelis, known for hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There', celebrates her 47th birthday on August 21st.

angles.name: Kelis's Birthday Vibes
angles.copy: My milkshake brings all the boys to the yard... because it's Kelis's 47th birthday this Friday! What's your favourite track from the R&B queen?

angles.name: R&B Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 47th birthday to the incredible Kelis this Friday, August 21st. Her music always gets us moving!

moments.title: Kacey Musgraves Turns 38
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning country and pop star Kacey Musgraves, known for her critically acclaimed albums, celebrates her 38th birthday on August 21st.

angles.name: Country Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 38th birthday to the brilliant Kacey Musgraves this Friday! What's your favourite song from the 'Golden Hour' singer?

angles.name: Modern Country Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Kacey Musgraves turning 38 this Friday! An artist who consistently pushes boundaries and delivers amazing music.

moments.title: Glenn Hughes (Deep Purple) Turns 74
moments.blurb: Legendary rock bassist and vocalist Glenn Hughes, known for his work with Deep Purple and Black Sabbath, celebrates his 74th birthday on August 21st.

angles.name: Rock Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 74th birthday to the 'Voice of Rock' himself, Glenn Hughes of Deep Purple and Black Sabbath fame, this Friday! What a career!

angles.name: Deep Purple Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible talent of Glenn Hughes, who turns 74 this Friday. His basslines and vocals are legendary.

moments.title: Scotland Schools Return
moments.blurb: Schools across Scotland have largely returned from their summer break this week, with pupils in areas like Glasgow and Edinburgh heading back to classrooms.

angles.name: Back to School Scotland
angles.copy: It's back to school for many across Scotland this week! Hope everyone had a great summer and is ready for the new term.

angles.name: Summer's End
angles.copy: The summer holidays are officially over for Scottish pupils! What's the one thing you're looking forward to (or dreading!) this new school year?

moments.title: Continued Warm UK Weather
moments.blurb: The UK is expected to see continued above-average temperatures and drier conditions through much of August, particularly in Southern regions.

angles.name: Summer Sticking Around
angles.copy: Looks like summer's not quite done with us yet! Expect more warm weather and sunshine across much of the UK this week.

angles.name: Devon Sunshine
angles.copy: More sunny intervals and mild temperatures are on the cards for Devon this week! Perfect for making the most of the last of the summer.

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Approaching
moments.blurb: The twin Reading & Leeds Festivals are set to take place over the August Bank Holiday weekend, from August 27th to 30th, with tickets currently on sale.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Just over a week until Reading & Leeds Festivals! Who's counting down the days to the August Bank Holiday weekend?

angles.name: Lineup Buzz
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is almost here! With a massive lineup spanning rock, pop, and dance, it's set to be an epic bank holiday. Have you got your tickets?

moments.title: Battle of the Atlantic Docuseries
moments.blurb: A new docuseries, 'Battle of the Atlantic: The U-Boat War', offering fresh insights into the naval conflict of WWII, starts streaming this Thursday, August 20th.

angles.name: WWII Docuseries
angles.copy: For history buffs: 'Battle of the Atlantic: The U-Boat War' begins streaming this Thursday, shedding new light on the crucial WWII conflict.

angles.name: New Historical Drama
angles.copy: Dive deep into a pivotal moment in history. 'Battle of the Atlantic: The U-Boat War' is a must-watch, starting Thursday.
